product.name: Showroom Shift Simulator - React port
product.description: Port original/showroom-shift-simulator.html to a reliable, tested React app with identical gameplay and look. Plan: docs/plan-react-port.md; decisions: docs/adr/; vocabulary: GLOSSARY.md.
product.note: The backlog when tracker.kind is local or none; with github the issues are the backlog. Prefer additive, opt-in changes over breaking the public API.

scaffold.description: Create the toolchain so every later ticket has green gates to build on. Vite + React 19 + strict TypeScript managed with bun; ESLint; Vitest + Testing Library (jsdom); Playwright (chromium) as a dev dependency with @axe-core/playwright and axe-core. package.json scripts: dev (vite on port 3000, strictPort), build, preview, lint, typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (vitest run), e2e (playwright test), gates (lint && typecheck && test && build). Bundle the Press Start 2P font locally (e.g. @fontsource/press-start-2p), no Google Fonts link. Create src/styles/tokens.css (CSS colour custom properties taken from the original's <style>) and src/game/palette.ts (canvas colour constants taken from the original's script). Update .forger/ui.json: tokens lists both src/styles/tokens.css and src/game/palette.ts; themes is ["light"] only. index.html viewport allows zoom (no maximum-scale or user-scalable=no) and keeps the original's title. App renders an empty Game Boy frame placeholder. Capture reference screenshots of the original (served as a static file) into docs/screenshots/original/ at the phone and desktop viewports. Write a short README (what it is, how to run, gates) and fill the 'What this repo is' section of .forger/process.md. original/ is reference only and is not built or served by the app.
acceptance_criteria: bun install && bun run gates passes on a clean checkout
bun run dev serves the app at http://localhost:3000
No request to fonts.googleapis.com; the font is served from the bundle
check ui passes: no raw colour literals in src/ outside tokens.css and palette.ts
.forger/ui.json lists both token files and only the light theme
The viewport meta does not disable zoom
docs/screenshots/original/ holds phone and desktop captures of the original
README documents dev, gates, e2e
reuse: original/showroom-shift-simulator.html <style> block for CSS colours and layout

sim-core.description: Port all game logic from the original's script into a pure module under src/game/ per ADR 1. config.ts holds every tuning number with the original's values (30 s shift at 60 steps/s, spawn every 135 steps while queue length < 5, patience 660 steps, 1.8x drain when unmanned, 1 s (60 steps) per tin on site, hub threshold > 5 tins in Round 2, clerk speed 2.4, customer speed 2.2, queue slots, clerk home/shaker positions, customer category roll thresholds and values, floater rise/fade). rng.ts is a small seeded PRNG (e.g. mulberry32). sim.ts exposes createInitialState(), startShift(state, round, rng) (resets stats and seeds the guaranteed 10-tin TRADE customer), step(state, rng) for one fixed step, serveAdvice(state) and processMix(state) actions, each returning the new state plus an events array (chime, whoosh, coins, humStart, humStop, dialogue text, roundEnded). Round flow: Round 1 end stores round1 stats; Round 2 end produces comparison data; replay resets to Round 1. Also export a pure deriveActionButtons(state) that returns the two buttons' enabled flag, title, subtitle and variant (mix | hub) exactly matching the original's updateActionButtons text. Preserve original quirks: leaving customers count toward the queue cap; patience drains while walking in; unmanned seconds accrue in every non-at_till clerk state.
acceptance_criteria: src/game/ imports nothing from react, the DOM, or audio, and never calls Math.random
A seeded full-shift replay with a scripted action sequence produces identical stats on every run (snapshot test)
Patience drains 1.8 per step when the clerk is not at_till and 1.0 otherwise; a customer at zero patience walks out, adding its value to lost and incrementing walkouts
processMix in Round 1 on a 10-tin order sends the clerk to the shaker for 10 s of mixing and the till is unmanned throughout
processMix in Round 2 on an order > 5 tins captures the value, increments hubOrders and leaves the clerk at_till; <= 5 tins still mixes on site
serveAdvice only acts on an ADVICE front customer with the clerk at_till
The shift ends after exactly 1800 steps and emits roundEnded with that round's stats
deriveActionButtons matches the original's labels for: no shift, clerk away, empty queue, advice customer, small mix, Round 2 hub order
Vitest coverage for src/game/ sim logic
reuse: original/showroom-shift-simulator.html sections 2-4 and 6 (Customer class, handle*Action, update(), startShift/endCurrentRound)

canvas-render.description: Port the original's 8-bit drawing (renderMartEnvironment, drawClerk, drawCustomer, drawSpeechBubble, mixing banner, COUNTER UNMANNED alert, patience gauges, floaters) to src/game/render.ts as functions of (ctx, state) using colours from palette.ts only. Visual randomness (shaker jitter) must not consume the sim RNG. A GameCanvas React component owns a 320x288 canvas (pixelated, CSS-scaled), and a useGameLoop hook runs requestAnimationFrame: accumulate real elapsed time capped at 250 ms per frame, run as many fixed sim steps as fit, skip advancing while document.hidden, then render once. Wait for document.fonts.load of Press Start 2P before the first text draw. Replace the emoji in the unmanned banner with a pixel-drawn warning glyph or plain text so it renders in the pixel font. Loop stops on unmount. The sim state is exposed to React through a small store (useSyncExternalStore) for later tickets.
acceptance_criteria: Game speed is independent of refresh rate: a unit test of the loop driver with fake timestamps at 60 Hz and 120 Hz advances the same number of steps per second of real time
A 10 s gap (or hidden tab) advances at most 250 ms of game time
render.ts contains no raw colour literals; check ui passes
The canvas matches docs/screenshots/original/ for the start state (screenshot updated under docs/screenshots/)
Unmounting GameCanvas cancels the animation frame (test)

hud-controls.description: Build the React shell around the canvas matching the original: Game Boy frame with brand bar (title, PWR LED, mute button placeholder wired later), screen bezel with sub-status bar (round tag and SHIFT timer), canvas, dialogue box, the two action buttons and the four KPI cards (CAPTURED, WALKOUTS, UNMANNED, HUB ORDERS). Button labels and enabled state come from deriveActionButtons; KPIs and timer from the store. The dialogue box is an aria-live=polite region. Keyboard: 1 serves advice, 2 or Space processes the mix, only while a shift is active, preventDefault so Space does not scroll. Buttons are real <button>s with visible focus styles. Styles in CSS modules or plain CSS using tokens.css variables. UI states: before first shift (buttons disabled, default labels), shift running with clerk at till, clerk away (TILL UNMANNED / MIXING Ns), queue empty (WAITING / STAND BY), after shift ended (disabled).
acceptance_criteria: Testing Library tests: clicking each button and pressing 1 / 2 / Space dispatch the right action only when enabled
Button titles and subtitles match the original for each UI state listed
KPIs show GBP values with the pound sign and unmanned seconds floored, as the original
Dialogue region has aria-live=polite
Layout holds at 390 px wide without horizontal scroll; screenshots in docs/screenshots/ updated and comparable to docs/screenshots/original/
check ui passes

round-modal.description: Port the overlay modal: Round 1 briefing (shown on load), Bottleneck report after Round 1 (captured, lost, walkouts, unmanned of 30 s), Comparison report after Round 2 (R1 vs R2 sales, lost, walkouts, key takeaway), with buttons START ROUND 1, START ROUND 2 (HUB MODEL) and REPLAY SIMULATION driving startShift. Copy matches the original; render as JSX, not innerHTML. Accessible dialog: role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby the header, focus moves to the action button on open and is trapped inside, Enter activates. The modal covers the canvas only, as in the original.
acceptance_criteria: Tests walk briefing -> Round 1 -> report -> Round 2 -> comparison -> replay with values taken from sim stats
Focus is on the modal action button whenever the modal opens; Tab does not leave the dialog
No dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Screenshots of each modal state added under docs/screenshots/

sound.description: Port SoftSoundFX to src/audio/sfx.ts: register chime, hub whoosh, losing coins, shaker hum, same frequencies, waveforms and gains. Takes an injectable AudioContext factory so tests use a fake. The context is created lazily on the first user gesture and resumed if suspended. Sim events (chime, whoosh, coins, humStart, humStop) drive it. Fix the original's defects: the hum stops on round end, on mute and on unmount; muting while the hum plays silences it. Mute toggle in the brand bar (SFX: ON / OFF, LED colour change) is persisted in localStorage with try/catch; it defaults to on when storage is unavailable. Missing AudioContext support degrades silently without errors.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests with a fake AudioContext: each sound schedules the original's oscillator frequencies; no sound plays when muted
Hum stops on roundEnded, on mute and on unmount (tests)
Mute survives a reload via localStorage; a throwing localStorage does not break the app (test)
No AudioContext is constructed before a user gesture

e2e-a11y.description: Playwright end-to-end tests against the dev or preview server on port 3000 using page.clock to fast-forward game time: play Round 1 and Round 2 by keyboard only, reach the comparison report and replay. Run axe (@axe-core/playwright) on the briefing, mid-shift and report states at phone and desktop viewports. Regenerate docs/screenshots/ with the forger screenshot command and run check a11y. The e2e script is not part of gates (needs a browser); document how to run it in the README.
acceptance_criteria: bun run e2e passes: both rounds completed by keyboard, comparison report shown, replay returns to Round 1
Zero serious or critical axe violations in every captured state
docs/screenshots/ regenerated by the screenshot command
README explains running e2e and a11y
